Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: single transparent production entrance sprite for the dark fantasy isometric action RPG Embergrave.
Input image: existing entrance sprite, used as style and viewpoint reference and replaced entrance target.
Primary request: Change the entrance graphic so the player can recognize the arena it leads to. Sanctuary of the Broken Oath: a wide low frozen granite sanctuary doorway reached by icy steps. Cracked oath-knight statues guard the sides, with snow caught on worn stone. Beyond the open entrance, show a small glimpse of the frozen octagonal sanctuary floor and its broken central oath sigil. Cold blue ward braziers at the sides. The ice, oath statues and octagonal interior make its destination unmistakable.
Style: match the supplied richly painted game architecture, tactile aged masonry and metal, detailed dark fantasy illustration, no cartoon outlines, consistent soft light from top left.
Composition: ONE complete isolated entrance assembly with its attached small approach and its interior glimpse, on genuine transparent RGBA background. Fixed orthographic isometric 2:1 ground perspective, looking down about 30 degrees, viewing the front and right faces. Center it with generous transparent margins. The walk-through mouth is central and clear; anchor is center of the frontmost walkable threshold. Keep the footprint compact enough for a three-unit game entrance. The interior glimpse belongs inside the entrance, not a separate panel or a large background scene. Preserve sharp readable silhouette at 250 pixels tall. No people, no boss bodies, no text, no letters, no icons, no frame, no sheet, no grid, no cast shadows outside the compact footprint. Do not crop any object edge. Preserve transparency.
